observations.statement: The supported Mezo network records expose an EVM JSON-RPC capability, but do not claim every optional Ethereum method or feature.
observations.workflowConsequence: Declare and probe the exact methods a workflow needs; do not infer optional capabilities from chain identity.

observations.statement: During the bounded 2026-08-18 probe, the unauthenticated dRPC mainnet endpoint rejected a JSON-RPC batch larger than three while accepting the tested methods individually.
observations.validity: Point-in-time provider and plan observation only.
observations.workflowConsequence: Batch size is a provider capability; split or fall back without changing required/optional item semantics.

observations.statement: Officially listed Mezo providers had different outcomes during the bounded probe, including successful responses and point-in-time HTTP/WebSocket failures.
observations.validity: Endpoint status must be rechecked after the network catalog review date or before sensitive use.
observations.workflowConsequence: Select only eligible fresh providers, assert chain identity after failover, and do not treat one failure as permanent unavailability.

limitations: These observations do not establish archive access, subscriptions, debug methods, transaction-pool behavior, rate limits, or provider uptime.
No Mezo-specific transaction deviation from standard EVM receipt semantics is promoted here.
